name: @proactive-agent/adapters
description: ProactiveAgent host adapters: unified harness adapter layer for proactive memory & suggestions across agent hosts (Claude Code, Kimi Code, Cursor, Cline, Codex). Zero-runtime-dependency.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js && tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --skipLibCheck --downlevelIteration --target es2022 --outDir dist src/index.ts
